name: Customer Payment Reversal V 13
definition: Scope|The CustomerPaymentReversal message is sent by the initiating party to the next party in the payment chain. It is used to reverse a payment previously executed.|Usage|The CustomerPaymentReversal message is exchanged between a non-financial institution customer and an agent to reverse a CustomerDirectDebitInitiation message that has been settled. The result will be a credit on the debtor account.|The CustomerPaymentReversal message refers to the original CustomerDirectDebitInitiation message by means of references only or by means of references and a set of elements from the original instruction.|The CustomerPaymentReversal message can be used in domestic and cross-border scenarios.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual transactions included in the message.

OriginalGroupInformation.name: Original Group Information
OriginalGroupInformation.definition: Information concerning the original group of transactions, to which the message refers.

OriginalPaymentInformationAndReversal.name: Original Payment Information And Reversal
OriginalPaymentInformationAndReversal.definition: Information concerning the original payment information, to which the reversal message refers.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

GroupReversalAndPaymentInformationNotPre.definition: If GroupHeader/GroupReversal is true, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndReversal is not allowed.

GroupReversalAndReasonRule.definition: If GroupHeader/GroupReversal is true, then OriginalGroupInformation/ReversalReasonInformation/Reason must present.

GroupReversalAndNumberOfTransactionsGuid.definition: If GroupHeader/GroupReversal is false and OriginalPaymentInformationAndReversal[*]/PaymentInformationReversal is false, then NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of OriginalPaymentInformationAndReversal[*]/TransactionInformation.

GroupReversalAndPaymentInformationPresen.definition: If GroupHeader/GroupReversal is false, then at least one occurrence of OriginalPaymentInformationAndReversal must be present.

SupplementaryDataRule.definition: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.
